training_overlap_caveat: The adapter uses KSC2 and Golos. The 31 public clips and public telephone demonstrations are external to those declared training corpora, but absence from all pretraining data cannot be verified.
execution: LoRA merged into FP32 base. Main limited suite uses PyTorch BF16; separately labelled FP32/dynamic-INT8/CTranslate2 smoke controls. CPU only, no cloud audio upload, no product model replacement.

historical_environment.purpose: Observed package versions for interpreting the archived measurements; not an installation specification.
historical_environment.security_limitations: The historical certifi, setuptools, torch and transformers versions have published advisories. Some PyTorch/Transformers records have no published fix. A supported reproduction environment requires separate security, compatibility and numerical validation. No installation requirements file is distributed with this archive.
